forecast_seconds: Two times the pooled median interval between consecutive valid nonbaseline advertising-window starts in the old development campaign. Only timestamps determine this conversion; confirmation timing and outcomes never set it.
sample_timestamp: ceil(primary_available_ms), converted to OpenMetrics seconds. Never window midpoint or window start; no interpolation or sample duplication.
rule: Native predict_linear per raw requirement gauge; OR of predicted requirement failures. Only currently valid, safe, frozen-observer-eligible decisions. No fitting, smoothing, clipping, threshold adjustment, or outcome-triggered selection.
coverage: At least two finite samples for every gauge inside the selected range. Missing/nonfinite predictions are unavailable, not negative or no alert. Compare the frozen ILR rule on the same covered known-target decisions for each lookback; retain full original counts separately.
scope: Retrospective practical-method benchmark on already examined confirmation data, not independent confirmation of this newly specified baseline. The disk-capacity alert family motivates the method, not these SLO gauges, minute-scale lookbacks or zero persistence. No guaranteed coordinate superiority or production claim.
